name: syGlass Learn
summary:
**Learn Anatomy in a More Immersive Way**

Launching with a complete undergraduate-level Anatomy course, syGlass Learn showcases how immersive lecture recordings can support deeper understanding of the human body. Learners can follow structured lessons, review challenging concepts, and explore anatomical relationships in a way that feels more interactive than traditional video.
